description: This file defines internal interfaces related to consistent ring topology management in Orleans. It includes the IConsistentRingProvider interface for managing ring responsibilities and range change subscriptions, as well as IRingRangeListener to handle range change notifications.

classes.name: IConsistentRingProvider
classes.description: Interface for a provider managing consistent ring responsibilities, subscriptions, and primary silo determination based on keys.

classes.name: IRingRangeListener
classes.description: Interface for objects that listen to range change notifications in the consistent ring.

methods.name: GetMyRange
methods.description: Returns the responsibility range of the current silo.

methods.name: SubscribeToRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribe to receive notifications about range changes.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribe from receiving range change notifications.

methods.name: GetPrimaryTargetSilo
methods.description: Determines the responsible silo for a specific key based on consistent hashing.

methods.name: RangeChangeNotification
methods.description: Notifies listeners of a change in the ring range.
